You would be wise to subscribe to the new one.|Darth Vader|''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''}} '''''Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader''''' is a novel written by [[James Luceno]] and published by [[Del Rey]]. ''Dark Lord'' takes place in the immediate aftermath of the events in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and focuses on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his rise to prominence in the newly-inaugurated [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Author Luceno devotes much of ''Dark Lord'' to the internal conflict that Darth Vader undergoes as he tries to slough off his former identity of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] intends for these early missions that he sends Vader on to be as much about learning what it means to be a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as they are about consolidating the rule of the nascent Empire. The [[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] was narrated by [[Jonathan Davis]]. This book was included in the Essential Legends Collection, with a trade paperback released in [[February 4]], [[2025]]. The accompanying unabridged audiobook was read by [[Marc Thompson]].{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/104272/dark-lord-star-wars-legends-by-james-luceno|text=Dark Lord: Star Wars Legends}} [[Inkstone Books]] released a collectible version in June 2025, limited to 500 copies.{{WebCite|url=https://inkstonebooks.com/product/dark-lord|text=Star Wars: Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader by James Luceno - Limited Edition|work=[https://inkstonebooks.com Inkstone Books]|archivedate=20260117220539}}
